maximum_depth_rule: All 673 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered document, PDF location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The 2021 to 2025 plan, outcome indicators, fiscal 2023 to 2025 measure and project evaluations, reference values, administrative evaluation, and next-plan consultation materials remain separate versions and layers.
non_goals: Do not add the 688 registered candidate rows as if they were 688 independent canonical outcomes.
Do not merge measure evaluation, project evaluation, annual versions, or next-plan materials without reviewed linkage.
Do not convert evaluation classes, budget information, or mixed multi-year values into verified achievement rates.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
